verdict.rationale: Omarchy's Menu has an Install section (e.g., Install > Development) that lets users add apps like VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime, Helix via keyboard-driven menus, and community reports confirm it ships with many popular apps (Zoom, Spotify, Steam, etc.) pre-bundled. However, this is a keyboard-navigated installer/menu system rather than a true graphical 'app store' with one-click browsing, and no evidence describes a curated storefront UI.
